description: Final cross-FEAT integration polish and documentation of manual-only verification. After FEAT-001..003, run the whole loop end-to-end one more time, tidy the new UI to the clean/neutral 'refined tabletop golf' direction (flat panels, existing theme font, navy/cream + brass accent — no new art), confirm no stray debug prints or scratch files remain, and record in the PR what can only be verified by code reading / manual play. This feature introduces no new mechanics; it is the convergence/cleanup pass. Depends on all prior FEATs.
steps: Run the full harness and both clean-build commands; confirm the complete loop deal-hand -> play club -> optionally play modifiers -> aim 6 dirs -> preview footprint -> Shoot -> resolve (carry+roll+wind+slope) -> ball moves toward hole -> scoring computed (reward layer) -> hole-out, with fixed-seed determinism.

Tidy the new UI: ShootButton + 2D hand strip + footprint preview readout use flat panels, the existing theme/custom_font, navy/cream with a brass accent for the primary Shoot action; no decorative framing, no new art assets. Do NOT touch theme/ or assets/ beyond referencing existing resources.
Remove any temporary debug asserts/prints or scratch files added during implementation (the test harness under scripts/tests/ and scenes/tests/ stays, marked test-only).
Confirm project.godot run/main_scene is still uid://i0lqex70w705 (scenes/GOLF.tscn) — unchanged.

In the final report / PR description, explicitly state what is only verifiable by code reading / manual play: the FEEL of the weighted variance, the live preview brightness mapping, camera/animation polish, UI layout aesthetics, and that WCAG/accessibility of the new UI is not validated here. Note the 2 pre-existing font errors (uid://csixfh5trj68q) are the accepted baseline, not new regressions.
acceptance_criteria: AC12: the headless harness runs the full loop and exits 0.
Both clean-build commands report 0 new script errors (only the accepted 2 pre-existing font errors remain).
No stray debug prints/scratch files remain; the test harness is the only test-only addition.
The new UI is clean/neutral per the art direction and adds no new art assets.
verification: Run the two clean-build commands -> 0 new errors.
git -C /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/gameloop status --short -> only intended source files changed (no models/textures/assets .import churn staged).
Commit any final changes on feature/gameloop-v1.
findings:
FEAT-004 complete. Convergence / cleanup / documentation pass over FEAT-001..003. No new mechanics introduced.

VERIFICATION (before == after; the only source change this FEAT made is the ShootButton font-color tidy in main_ui.tscn):
- GATE 1 headless run (build_command): 0 errors (grep empty) BEFORE and AFTER.
- GATE 2 editor import (--editor --quit | grep 'SCRIPT ERROR|parse error'): 0 errors BEFORE and AFTER.
- GATE 3 harness scenes/tests/test_turn_loop.tscn: 40 checks, 0 failures, exit 0 BEFORE and AFTER.
- Accepted baseline unchanged: the 2 pre-existing font errors (missing uid://csixfh5trj68q, the theme default_font Unbounded-VariableFont_wght.ttf referenced by theme/kenneyUI-green.tres) are NOT script errors and were not touched (theme/ is off-limits). No NEW errors introduced.

STEP 1 (full loop end-to-end): confirmed. The harness exercises deal-hand -> play club (band fields from CLUB_STATS, R#4) -> optionally play modifiers -> aim all 6 dirs (valid footprints) -> preview footprint (weighted disk) -> execute_shot -> board resolution (carry + roll + wind head/tail + crosswind sign R#5 + green slope nudge, R#2 roll/tree/water walk) -> ball moves toward hole (AC7 start 19 -> landing 4) -> scoring reward layer (AC8 final_score == round(chips*mult) == 121, from the AIMED CENTER per R#1) -> and tree/water stop + punch-through-tree. Determinism holds (AC6: two seeded runs land identically). The live GOLF.tscn (uid://i0lqex70w705) also loads headless with 0 script errors (FEAT-003 AC1), so the live loop and the harness both pass.

STEP 2 (UI tidy): the new UI already matched the refined-tabletop direction from FEAT-003 (ShootButton = flat StyleBoxFlat, brass bg Color(0.72,0.53,0.26) + lighter-brass border, muted-brown disabled style, bottom-center; HandStrip = flat StyleBoxFlat navy-green panel with %ClubRow/%ModifierRow HBoxes; both inherit the existing theme/kenneyUI-green.tres default_font = the theme custom font, no new art). The ONE change made here: added legible cream font colors to ShootButton (font_color 0.96,0.93,0.84; hover white; pressed cream; disabled muted cream 0.7,0.67,0.6) so the primary Shoot action reads clearly on brass in all states (the inherited theme font_color was black and font_disabled_color was near-invisible 0.9,0.9,0.9,0.2). No new art assets; theme/ and assets/ untouched.

STEP 3 (cleanliness): no temporary debug asserts/prints or scratch files were added by this task. turn_controller.gd and all 6 new effect scripts contain zero print()/print_debug()/printerr(). The noisy [ShotManager]/[ModifierManager]/[EffectSimpleStat] prints seen in harness output are PRE-EXISTING (e.g. [ShotManager] debug came from commit 4d8b7d8, long before FEAT-001 ecf8376) and are out of scope for surgical edits. The harness (scripts/tests/test_turn_loop.gd + scenes/tests/test_turn_loop.tscn, uid://b2turnloopharness01) is the only test-only addition and stays.

STEP 4: project.godot run/main_scene is still uid://i0lqex70w705 (scenes/GOLF.tscn) - unchanged.

FINDING 7 (swing-hand retirement cleanliness): confirmed. Grep shows ZERO live references to the 2D SwingHand (scripts/ui/swing_hand.gd / scenes/ui/swing_hand.tscn) and ZERO live references to the SwingHand3D SubViewport chain (scripts/swing_hand_3d.gd). The only remaining mentions are documentation comments in hex_grid.gd (line ~2319), card_system_manager.gd (lines ~24/681), and a stale doc-comment in the orphaned, out-of-scope scripts/ui/shot_panel.gd - none are dangling code references. Both retirements (the two separate grep-guarded retirements) left no dangling refs.

PINNED RESOLUTIONS re-verified across the whole feature set (all EXACT): R#1 ctx.aim_tile=center drives chips via get_shot_distance(); _simulate_ball_path stays the 2-tile [start,landing] stub. R#2 apply_board_resolution reconstructs the roll line via _get_neighbor_in_direction with per-step parity (tile.x%2==1), stop before OOB/WATER, stop before TREE unless punch/stinger, mutates landing_tile in place. R#3 _resolve_landing_tile fast-path gated on metadata['footprint_built'] ALONE (line 283); the aoe_weights.size()>0 at line 325 is the LEGACY-path weighted-selection branch, not the trigger. R#4 all 12 CLUB_STATS rows have distance == band_center (DRIVER 24, etc.), harness asserts DRIVER. R#5 _apply_perp_shift uses (d+2)%6 for +shift and (d+4)%6 for -shift; harness proves both crosswind signs.

MANUAL / CODE-READING-ONLY VERIFICATION (per step 5 - NOT covered by the headless gates; reviewer/merge should validate by play or inspection): (1) the FEEL of the weighted-variance landing (how 'fair' the spread + terrain_factor weighting feels in play); (2) the live footprint-preview brightness mapping (on-board 3D highlight intensity proportional to aoe_weights, center marker) - rendered, not asserted; (3) camera framing and ball-flight / bounce animation polish; (4) UI layout aesthetics and readability at real resolution (the brass-on-cream Shoot contrast, hand-strip placement); (5) WCAG / accessibility of the new UI is NOT validated here (no contrast-ratio audit, no assistive-tech testing). Full accessibility validation would require manual testing with assistive technologies and expert review. The 2 pre-existing font errors (uid://csixfh5trj68q) are the accepted baseline, NOT new regressions.

MERGE NOTES: only intended source files committed for this FEAT (scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn + this FEAT JSON); the worktree's unrelated *.import churn under assets/ and models/ was deliberately NOT staged (git add of specific files only, never git add -A). Branch feature/gameloop-v1, committed locally, not pushed. The dormant seams FEAT-003 flagged (deal_hand_for_hole ready for curated HoleDefinition/HandDefinition .tres; empty %ClubRow/%ModifierRow awaiting card-widget population; _apply_hole_definition_overrides fixed-grid path) remain available for the next milestone and are intentionally not wired, as FEAT-004 introduces no new mechanics.
